column1: # Every notice of the three listed buyers of Nvidia's RTX PRO 5500 cards (Tianyang Technology, 300872; Youzu, 002174; Hangzhou Yuanlin, 300649) on the disclosure site cninfo.com.cn, dated Oct 1 to Nov 25, 2026, that tables/rtx5500_notices.tsv does not already hold, together with the Shenzhen exchange's own letter to Tianyang of Oct 17, 2026 (from the exchange's site): 26 rows (Tianyang 12, the letter among them; Youzu 12; Hangzhou Yuanlin 2). Made on Nov 25, 2026: the site's own list of each company's notices for those dates was taken whole (12, 14 and 5 notices; control: each buyer's purchase notice is in its list), and each notice not yet held was saved and read. Columns: the first nine as in tables/rtx5500_notices.tsv (date, stock code, short name, title, the site's file path, downloaded, the characters of the saved text with spaces removed, names_card = whether that text holds pro5500 or rtx5500 once spaces are removed and case is ignored, the saved file's sha256); then the saved id, whether the notice is dated before or after that buyer's own purchase notice (15 are after, one of them on the same day), and a reading of what the notice says on the cards. What the table is not: it records what was filed; a company that files nothing on a delivery has not thereby said that nothing was delivered.
